ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with high-intensity (white) mottled regions localized at the distal tips. Estimated 70:30 black-to-white pixel distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity region covering the central fluke and peduncle attachment. High-intensity white stippling and linear mottling clustered at the distal 25% of both left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with a sharp vertex and approximately 50-degree aperture.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with varying amplitude. Right lobe shows high-frequency, sharp jagged peaks; left lobe exhibits lower frequency, more rounded serrated contours.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve initiating with convexity at the median notch, transitioning to a slight concavity mid-lobe, and ending in convex distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity circular pixel points visible along the leading edges and within the white mottled zones of the distal lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous vertical and diagonal high-intensity linear tracks (rake marks) crossing the black pigmentation on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring across the ventral surface; distinct jagged notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe distal to the median notch.
